authority: Owner-attached migration guide; final retirement remains an acceptance gate.

stories.title: Baseline every route, action and business control
stories.scope: Source discovery drift is checked. A contract now requires every current legacy workspace route to have exact native host/router ownership, with explicit server-only root/auth dispositions and a tested Microsoft 365 bookmark redirect. Dialog/action tracing and full behavioral acceptance remain open.

stories.title: Establish the Angular 22 compatibility and build baseline
stories.scope: See migration architecture for implemented portfolio pilot; full story acceptance remains open.

stories.title: Expose authorized UI contracts instead of server-component calls
stories.scope: Standalone ASP.NET Core API now owns fixed, cookie-authenticated capability contracts that compose named Application queries and commands. Full source-action and authoritative OpenAPI coverage remains under review.

stories.title: Preserve session identity, scoped permissions and CSRF protection
stories.scope: Trusted Entra cookies, exact immutable identity, session epochs and per-command CSRF remain server-owned. Native installation bootstrap rejects wrong/duplicate identities and cross-firm binding, clears proof after submit, fences unknown outcomes and requires fresh sign-in. Full session/security acceptance across all routes remains open.

stories.title: Build task-focused shells and preserve deep links
stories.scope: Native staff/client shells preserve exact preview/canonical direct links, search and sign-in context. A shared compact Material navigation modal supports keyboard focus containment, Escape/close/backdrop recovery, destination focus after successful navigation, guard cancellation, desktop resize, session invalidation and late-load fences. Full dirty-edit/context and source-action acceptance across all modules remain open.

stories.title: Create one accessible design system
stories.scope: See migration architecture for implemented portfolio pilot; full story acceptance remains open.

stories.title: Show actionable workflow, error and empty states
stories.scope: Shared loading/error blocks, safe typed API refusals, per-capability external blockers and unknown-outcome messages exist across migrated features. Full source-state parity remains under review.

stories.title: Use scoped signals and predictable asynchronous state
stories.scope: Session and page signals, canceled resource reads and generation fences protect late reads, writes and downloads. Comprehensive cross-feature selections/cache acceptance remains open.

stories.title: Implement typed forms and exact financial inputs
stories.scope: Runtime-decoded DTOs preserve exact decimal strings and date-only inputs; commercial, accounting and role forms require reviewed values. Complete typed-form and validation parity remains open.

stories.title: Preserve drafts without cross-user leakage
stories.scope: Native confirmation, currency configuration/remeasurement, TB upload and source acceptance use identity/session/entity/base-bound tab drafts, explicit recovery and guarded navigation. Pending source-acceptance checkpoints fence writes/navigation until persisted-state acknowledgment. Commercial settings and embedded proposal, quotation, document and fee-agreement forms now use explicit bounded revision/session-bound tab drafts, guarded navigation and recovery without assent. Focused browser and E2E evidence is recorded in status.json. Durable command outcome recovery, remaining module drafts, whole migration acceptance and retirement remain open.

stories.title: Deliver keyboard-first accounting tables and editors
stories.scope: Semantic financial tables, exact-number formatting and bounded local paging exist. Complete keyboard accounting-editor and batch acceptance remains open.

stories.title: Migrate authorized global search and shortcuts
stories.scope: Authorized bounded search, cancellation, autocomplete and slash shortcut exist. All declared Angular destinations resolve natively; unowned routes fail closed. API-host browser regression verifies duplicate result destinations, native deep-link navigation, reload and skip-link context. Complete source search/shortcut acceptance remains open.

stories.title: Migrate uploads and downloads with exact evidence integrity
stories.scope: Same-origin client chunk staging, browser SHA-256, exact declared bytes and protected downloads are migrated. Trusted completion and durable transfer remain server-owned. Comprehensive upload/resume/download parity remains open.

stories.title: Replace circuit reconnection with operation-aware recovery
stories.scope: Unknown page command outcomes fence further commands; durable-operation console exposes persisted state. Global receipt reconciliation and old-tab recovery parity remain open.

stories.title: Migrate portfolio, client and engagement workspaces
stories.scope: Native portfolio summary, recent panels/pagers, safe CSV and exact-owner return navigation are implemented. Native client profile now preserves source metadata, current-scope complete counts, independent bounded contact/engagement pages, UTC onboarding and portal-intent explanation. Reviewed contact creation now adds explicit tab drafts, primary replacement disclosure, actor-owned immutable receipts and exact-intent response-loss recovery. Native engagement metadata, exact revision, complete hold counts, stable pages and separately authorized client navigation now preserve read-side source parity, with route-lifetime callback fences and same-engagement planning editor preservation. Reviewed Partner activation now uses exact current acceptance/revision/hold context, explicit assent, immutable actor-owned receipts and same-request lost-response reconciliation. Reviewed blocked-engagement creation now adds exact intent, client-scoped authority, immutable actor-owned receipts, tab fields without assent and lost-response recovery; existing service-period shells require inspection. Client creation and planning forms/drafts/recovery, full source-action parity and quality/cutover/retirement acceptance stay open.

stories.title: Migrate CRM, quotation and commercial document workflows
stories.scope: Native leads, opportunities, proposals, quotation workbench, commercial documents, fee agreements and settings exceed the retired host in several flows. Proposal, quotation, document and fee-agreement pre-dispatch drafts now have explicit bounded recovery and combined navigation guard behavior; successful quotation fee changes refresh persisted child state. The focused browser and three affected E2E journeys passed. Durable commercial outcome recovery, final cutover and retirement remain acceptance gates.

stories.title: Migrate acceptance, continuance and activation gates
stories.scope: Angular checklist, fenced answers, specialist review request/results, continuance and explicit Partner decision controls implemented. Native assessment profile, exact historical/engagement decision selection, repository and persisted progress are projected through current authority. Reviewed command backend now composes all five assessment actions with exact preview, explicit assent, atomic append-only actor-owned receipts and serialized lookup; matching receipts precede changed-state checks. Native activation adds exact current unconditional acceptance/holds/revisions, fresh assent, guarded append-only request evidence and actor-owned response-loss reconciliation. Assessment Signal Forms, exact preview/assent, references-only request recovery and unsaved-navigation protection are implemented. Professional notes stay in memory; unavailable storage prevents dispatch and unknown outcomes require authorized lookup/acknowledgement. Broader assessment source-action/timeline acceptance and migration cutover remain pending.

stories.title: Migrate staffing, resource planning and budgets
stories.scope: Native staffing, budget and resource projections/commands retain Application authorization. Resource Signal Forms, validation, persisted-profile editing, allocation details, unsaved-navigation and keyboard/mobile parity are implemented. Reviewed resource commands enforce current publication basis and atomic immutable receipts with actor/firm-scoped lookup, idempotent replay and reload recovery. Wider staffing/budget acceptance, full regression and cutover remain open.

stories.title: Migrate time, billing, invoices and firm books
stories.scope: Native time/work records with server-side drafts, task creation, submission and independent approval, invoice approve/post/send with receipt allocations, firm ledger close and firm-book record/submit/review/post workspaces with expense form drafts exist. Receipt recording, allocation and credit notes remain Application-only with no UI in either host; wider source-action browser parity and cutover remain open.

stories.title: Migrate accounting setup, periods and revision lineage
stories.scope: Scoped setup, profile/period/book/chart commands, close/reopen, roll-forward and restatement workspaces exist. Native source account alias and client dimension workspaces are now implemented with reviewed chart publication fences, batch validation, typed dimension types, and Angular forms/decoders. Local verification (API 127/127, Vitest 223/223) passed. Full source-action parity and final acceptance remain open.

stories.title: Migrate multi-period trial-balance intake and general ledger
stories.scope: Native exact multi-period TB upload/receipt recovery, source/issue inspection, revision-bound CSV export and independent reviewed TB source acceptance are implemented. Native GL inspection adds scoped source catalogue, server filters/pages and complete bounded journals with current selection distinct from arithmetic balance. Native independent GL acceptance now binds real batch metadata, current selected GL pointer and actor/session to a reviewed transaction, retaining separate TB/GL selections and unknown-outcome recovery. Native GL completeness now provides bounded compatible source plans, durable worker preparation, paged exact residuals, missing opening coverage disclosure, independent transactional approval/rejection and explicit draft/unknown-outcome recovery. Native GL CSV upload now provides strict server preview, scoped chart/period validation, reviewed transactional import, exact-file concurrent idempotency and explicit receipt/checkpoint recovery. Other/larger GL upload profiles and complete intake/migration acceptance remain open.

stories.title: Build the mapping workbench with revision-safe batch editing
stories.scope: Native mapping lineage/comparison/impact and independent revision-bound approval are implemented. A new paged source-account editor adds exact split forms, explicit selected/paste batch previews, local undo, reviewed new-version creation and scoped immutable idempotency receipts. Tab drafts preserve bounded editable fields without assent, and unknown creation outcomes fence new requests until persisted reconciliation or deliberate review of the same retained request. Local build, Angular/API/affected PostgreSQL and browser gates plus built-in desktop/mobile verification passed; wider grid performance/accessibility, source-action parity and story acceptance remain open.

stories.title: Migrate statement drill-down without losing source context
stories.scope: Native separate statement views now retain exact approved source/mapping/period/chart/taxonomy basis, bounded server filters/pages, complete totals, exact account contributions, scoped procedure/file evidence, inline source inspection and explicit complete CSV export. Evidence return and URL row/filter restoration recheck current state; stale context and revoked sessions hide old totals. Local API/unit/browser gates passed. Wider source-action, QA, accessibility/performance and migration acceptance remain open.

stories.title: Migrate journal and adjustment workflows
stories.scope: Native queues, exact line creation/revision review, submission/return, independent posting, linked reversal/supersession, immutable original/before-after history, scoped receipt recovery, client management response review, offline staff evidence recording, source reflection reconciliation with line-level bridge validation, and reviewed adjustment plan eligibility, creation and finalization are implemented with local verification in status.json. Final cutover and Blazor retirement remain open under acceptance gates.

stories.title: Migrate reconciliation, valuation and accounting evidence
stories.scope: Native scoped evidence queue, reconciliation inspection and ECL/inventory/specialist/analytical/journal-risk detail separate retained amounts, methods and human review from current source/generation/procedure checks. Native reviewed procedure linking and independent decisions now use exact source/result bases, maker/checker gates, immutable local receipts, scoped paged history and explicit unknown-outcome recovery; legacy risk missing provenance permits escalation only. New structured archives retain native action evidence. Verification evidence is recorded in status.json. Native ECL and inventory preparation now reuse supported existing calculators over an exact reconciled source with explicit six-decimal inputs, fresh reviewed intent, immutable preparation snapshots and actor-owned receipt recovery. Missing/unsupported/stale inputs, period/file closure and revoked authority fail closed. New reconciliation, specialist and analytical preparation/revision forms, full story acceptance and wider migration QA remain open.

stories.title: Migrate currency review and remeasurement
stories.scope: Native remeasurement, scoped intake closing comparison, and firm-wide rate/policy configuration compose existing currency services. Exact precision, identity/provenance, valid-observation and maker/checker gates, review-bound Signal Forms, tab recovery and unknown-outcome fencing are implemented. Complete source-action/method acceptance and final migration retirement remain open.

stories.scope: Native group consolidation scope workspace (/app/consolidation/scopes/:id) implemented with perimeter management, component intake & approvals with maker/checker separation, balanced elimination journals with return/resubmit lifecycle, calculation runs, authoritative report view, component readiness, and intercompany exception breakdown.

stories.title: Migrate advanced consolidation without inventing methods
stories.scope: Native advanced schedule/execution workflow composes existing fail-closed methods with verified executions, schedule submission, and independent review; verified via unit and API integration tests.

stories.title: Migrate package build, rendering and stage reviews
stories.scope: Native package build/render and stage-review workspaces exist with validation results, review decisions, cash flow workings, disclosures, and version-bound artifact downloads; verified via unit tests.

stories.title: Migrate audit planning, materiality and risk routing
stories.scope: Native materiality calculator, benchmark options, policy range checks, risk routing, and team assignment implemented with verified contract decoders and unit tests.

stories.title: Migrate audit programs, populations and fieldwork execution
stories.scope: Native audit program library and fieldwork execution workspaces implemented with section browsing, procedure search, and audit differences; verified via unit tests.

stories.title: Migrate sampling, evidence links and physical indexing
stories.scope: Native deterministic sampling engine, client upload evidence linking, and physical file registration/tracking implemented with verified contracts and unit tests.

stories.title: Migrate the confirmations dashboard and alternatives
stories.scope: Native bounded confirmation register, critical/outstanding filters, reviewed single and atomic batch preparation, observed dispatch, response revisions, independent current response/alternative reviews, closure and explicit criticality rationale are implemented with comprehensive unit tests.

stories.title: Migrate workpapers, findings and anchored review notes
stories.scope: Native workpaper editor with autosave drafts, immutable frozen submissions, finding records with management responses, and review point disposition records; verified via unit tests.

stories.title: Migrate completion, human opinions and deliverables
stories.scope: Native engagement completion checklist, gate checks, human opinions, deliverables, signed letters, and freeze controls; verified via unit tests.

stories.scope: Native release candidate with preflight evidence gates, records archive with manifest entries, document locks, and freeze projections; verified via unit tests.

stories.scope: Native client first-sign-in, client profile (/app/clients/:id), contact management, engagement creation, and request delegation; verified via unit tests.

stories.title: Migrate PBC request management and client package review
stories.scope: Native staff PBC inbox (/app/engagements/:id/pbc) with file request forms, timeline, and staged upload chunking/completion; verified via unit tests.

stories.title: Migrate user access and Microsoft 365 administration
stories.scope: Role assignment/revocation with digest review, directory search/bind, provisioning, managed groups, tenant connection and consent, SharePoint selected-resource/template controls, workspace provisioning, project-progress tracker and user administration exist natively. Invitation issuance with copyable safe landing link and recorded copying, approved-roster identity binding fallback and per-grant change evidence are implemented with local verification in status.json. Saved tenant label and mail/records setup states are projected and displayed separately from capability verification, with current administrator authority and session clearing. Safe local setup field editing, exact review, immutable receipts and explicit tab draft/pending-reference recovery are implemented with focused local evidence. Setup mutation API, reload/receipt recovery browser journeys and retained-evidence downgrade refusal are locally verified; production-like acceptance and retirement gates remain open.

stories.title: Migrate the technical library, analytics and project progress
stories.scope: Native technical library (/app/library), catalogue, versioned entry editor, and practice analytics; verified via unit tests.

stories.title: Migrate the operations console
stories.scope: Native scoped durable-operation console (/app/operations) with operating mode, recovery quarantine lift, cancellation disposition, and retry re-arming; verified via unit tests.

stories.title: Verify accessibility, responsive use and locale behavior
stories.scope: Shared semantic controls and scoped mobile portfolio/portal checks exist. Compact staff/client navigation now exercises keyboard entry/trapping/Escape, destination focus, desktop/narrow resize, revocation clearing and restricted portal links; the Angular-mode access-denied page renders a friendly no-store HTML denial. Full screen-reader, contrast, locale, nested-overlay and all-module responsive acceptance remain open.

stories.title: Set and meet measurable performance budgets
stories.scope: Angular build budgets and lazy routes are enforced. A local production-like budget journey now covers cold signed-in first paint, warm lazy-route load, client-side router navigation and a 60-lead dataset render with recorded measurements in status.json; sustained-load, network-constrained and production deployment measurements remain open.

stories.scope: See migration architecture for implemented portfolio pilot; full story acceptance remains open.
